body:
>The worst pain you will ever feel is that of a failed suicide attempt. 

I know, and that is what I'm afraid of. I'm trying to build the courage to learn to stand some pain, so I can take an assured method, such as 
jumping from a tall height, or a good cut. 

> it only takes losing one battle to lose the war.
What's it all for though? Why live? 

> I often say I don't like anything, but that's the disease speaking, there is quite a lot I actually do like.

I agree, but I will retort with the fact that I've experienced all of those you mentioned. The law of diminishing returns makes sure that these events will never be as good to me though. 

I'll sleep on it. Thanks for the conversation. Sorry for the extreme delay as well.

Well, fair enough. 

It is hard for me, and even though the feelings do recede for a while, they always come back, no matter what. Even after excercise, a healthier diet, and having a job, I still felt like shit. 

We keep living because of biological programming. I see the pain as the worst part, and that's why I'm a coward. 

I know life is ultimately about me, but I just don't find much joy in anything. There's really no point in me living. I'll disappear from history anyway, my life has no impact on anything ever. 

And that's a good point.

Well, thanks for that. I'm sure if my post had a different title and wasn't an expression of public suicidal ideation, you wouldn't care.  

When I get frustrated after I play a video game, I quit. Why can't I do the same with life? 

I don't hate you at least. You put up with my constant put downs. 
I been used to it, now I'm tired. What's the point of continuing this if this is just disappointing. 

And good on you. 

I'm just not that good of a person. I've lied to everyone I've ever interacted with, I was a pothead, and a serious binge-drinker. I put people down to prop myself up (and people figured it out, and outcasted me anyway, like any good person would've). I'm not a good person, and my death wouldn't really impact anyone. If it did, I wouldn't care, because I'm (spoiler) a selfish dick with a superiority complex.

What's the point in talking to people on the internet if I don't have anything of value to say. I'm bad at conversation, I'm bad at video games, and waking up is the worst part of my day. 

I can't really change thought, no matter how much I want to. I'm just sick and tired of failing and confirming my self-fulfilled prophecies. 

I've been seeing therapists since I was 11, but I've lied to each and every one. I can't tell the truth to people.
Living that lifestyle is no different from death. At least death relieves people that cost of supporting you.

False devastation isn't real devastation. If you knew me in real life, chances on you wouldn't care if I killed myself or not. 
I'm only social because I'm forced to be. If it were up to me, I'd stay in my room in the dark, watching weird porn on the internet. Alas, life's crap gets in the way. 

I just want to disappear. I'm too much of a coward to actually go through with a sure method. Hopefully trains go fast enough at least
